verdict.rationale: Jeeves' API docs show a versioned path (POST /v1/cards/transactions), which implies URL-based API versioning. Nothing in the pack documents a deprecation policy, version lifecycle, or changelog, and the OpenAPI spec probes returned 404. missing for 10: documented deprecation policy, explicit versioning scheme documentation, changelog/sunset timelines, independent corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can rely on versioned APIs with a documented deprecation policy

citations.quote: Use POST /v1/cards/transactions with the source field to query card or travel transactions in a single endpoint.
